description: Payload contract between TinyRL edge nodes and the central system (human UI or AI agent). Envelope fields are generic; meas keys come from the node's feature profile (see State/node_info).

State/condition.cadence: on state or condition_id change + on (re)connect

state.desc: idle=fresh node, learn=calibrating/fitting, ok=monitoring quiet, alarm=episode active

condition_id.desc: <label> = slug from condition library; unknown = OPEN ASK for a label

episode_s.desc: seconds since episode open (0 when quiet)

State/event.cadence: per episode transition: open | close | label

summary.desc: human-readable one-liner, e.g. 'g100-01: i=4.06A, slip=1.13Hz, vdc=571V, tq=77.2% for 38s'

meas.desc: feature -> mean value over the episode, keys = profile feature names

features.desc: [{name, unit}...] - defines the meas key vocabulary

Action/feedback.direction: central -> node, QoS1, the ONLY input channel

label.desc: answer an open 'unknown' episode; creates or reinforces a condition; by = human|agent|console

state_persistence.model_bin: score stats + theta + frozen ranges + normalizer moments (v4)
state_persistence.conditions_jsonl: one condition per line: id, centroid c[], count, first/last, src

breaking_changes_vs_mvp_v3: State/event: flat i_mean/slip_mean/vdc_mean/tq_mean replaced by generic 'meas' map
Action/feedback 'label' now also accepts by=agent (was human|console only in practice)
Old /model.bin (v3 histogram model) is ignored - press 's' to relearn once
Strtof-separator bug in conditions.jsonl reload fixed: centroids no longer zero out after reboot
